<style>
.si-landing{

.si-landing .hero h1{

}

.si-landing .btn-primary{

}
.si-landing .btn-secondary{

}

}

}

}

.si-landing .divider-quote{

}
.si-landing .divider-quote span{

/* ---- INVERSION Y HORARIO ---- */
.si-landing .inversion{background:var(--verde-bosque);padding:56px 0;}

.si-landing footer{background:var(--verde-bosque);color:var(--verde-menta);padding:40px 0 30px;}
